beta_overlay._basis: M3 (PREREG quant_research docs/PREREG_m3_beta_overlay_executed_book_2026-09-23.md, 24c3f803f; implementation docs/IMPL_m3_beta_overlay_2026-09-23.md): BTCUSDT overlay leg = -sum_i w_exec,i*beta_i on the EXECUTED book (after POP->RESHAPE->CLAMP), added after the reshape as an independent leg; betas from the producer's target_live field `beta_overlay` (version m3_beta_v1).
beta_overlay._semantics: off (default; also when this block is absent) = the executor without M3, byte for byte. shadow = validate the field, compute and record the hedge that WOULD be placed (anchors row m3_beta_overlay); book, orders and loop state identical to off. on = place the leg, scaled so the combined target gross (book + leg) <= max_combined_leverage x NAV (key `max_combined_leverage`, ABSENT here on purpose: whether the leg sits inside or outside the leverage budget is a user ruling; absent under on = the leg is refused, never unlimited). Any other value (or an invalid budget) = a BROKEN config: HIGH page, no new leg, and a leg already held is FROZEN at its held value (not unwound). Switching takes effect at the next anchor process; an EXPLICIT off or shadow after on unwinds the held BTC hedge through the existing clamp/flatten_only reduce-only channel (it becomes an ordinary held dust/non-target name). Changing this block is a book-behaviour change: user ruling required (CLAUDE.md constraint 5).
